classified_object.notes: Product-centered hybrid; must not silently classify boxing the sport.

performance_agency.summary: Player motor skill and timing affect in-game outcomes.

performance_interface.summary: Headset and motion controllers track upper-body actions; legs often weakly represented.

embodied_performance.summary: Headset and motion controllers track upper-body actions; legs often weakly represented. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Virtual ring constrains interaction; physical play space required for safe movement.

distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Software resolves events; formal contest authority is weak or mode-specific.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Each participant's physical play space has local safety constraints.

sensing_tracking.summary: Controller/headset tracking claimed; independent athletic validation limited in this record.

measurement.summary: In-game hits, stamina, knockouts, fitness targets; cross-device metrics unclear.

officiation.summary: Software determines outcomes; limited formal athletic officiation.

outcome_openness.summary: PvP modes can produce open contested outcomes.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Embodied tracking and computational arena jointly affect performance; immersion alone is insufficient.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Spatial athletic system candidate at product level; sport status requires governed contest evidence.

content: League/federation-governed VR boxing rules with integrity model.
